description: Permanently delete one sender (From) profile. This cannot be undone. Deletion is refused when this is the company's last sender or when a live campaign, active sequence (including a step-level override), or transactional email still uses it. Draft and rejected campaigns plus the account default are reassigned to the best remaining sender when needed; read fallbackSenderProfileId in the result and review that identity before sending. Reply-to profiles are not supported by this tool. Get the profile ID from list_sender_profiles. Requires the companies:manage scope.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

profileId.description: Sender (From) profile ID to delete, from senderProfiles in list_sender_profiles.

name: delete_sender_profile

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_sender_profile` MCP tool.

deletedSenderProfileId.description: ID of the sender profile that was permanently deleted.

fallbackSenderProfileId.description: Remaining sender profile selected for the account default and eligible draft campaigns when reassignment was needed.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
